page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 347 at right. Below it a heading line "S. Bonorum corporis." at full width. Bonorum animi." at full width, followed by a block of text in lines with mixed columns (left list and right list with entries). Then heading "V. Statuum." followed by two columns of entries (left: Agricolarum etc.; right: Medardus etc.). A small mark at the bottom right corner.

page.notes: Printed text is set in a mix of italic and roman; the marginal and column-heavy layout was simplified into lines. Some words in the italic and damaged areas (e.g. "Praeclara", "Pro impetratio", "Catharina") are uncertain. Left and right columns of the tables are marked with separators.
